text:
A: Hello. Can you hear me all right?
B: Yeah, I can hear you. You alright?
A: Not bad, thanks. Lee.
B: Darren. Alright, mate.
A: Er, so I suppose we just chat, do we?
B: That's what it said. Three minutes.
A: Right. Where are you based, then?
B: Maidstone. Kent. You?
A: Hucknall. Just north of Nottingham.
B: Yeah, I know roughly. Never been, mind.
A: Not many people have, to be fair. What do you do?
B: Bins. Refuse and recycling, for the contractor that does the council rounds. Eleven years on and off. Six o'clock start, so I'm usually knackered by about now.
A: Six. That's early.
B: Up at five. You get used to it. Dog's not keen though. What about you?
A: Er, I'm a quality technician. Aerospace components, so machined parts. I check them on a measuring machine, a CMM, and write up the reports if something's out of tolerance. And I look after the calibration records.
B: So you're the one that tells people they've done it wrong.
A: Sort of, yeah. More or less. I've got two junior inspectors as well.
B: Same as me with the new lads, then. They skip half a road and leave the bags split all over the pavement, and then guess who gets the phone call.
A: Yeah. It's the same principle, I'd say. If it's not done properly it comes back on you.
B: Exactly that.
A: How long have you been there? Sorry, you said eleven years.
B: Eleven, yeah. You?
A: Nineteen at this place. One firm before that. Started as an apprentice at sixteen.
B: Nineteen years. Fair play. That puzzle bit at the start, I bet you was good at that, then.
A: Er, I got most of them. One I didn't finish in time. Annoyed me a bit, to be fair.
B: I gave up on the last one. Couldn't see the point.
A: Do you follow football at all?
B: Gillingham. Which is, you know. Suffering, basically. Go a few times a season with a mate.
A: Notts County, me. So I know the feeling.
B: Yeah, you lot have had it rough an' all.
A: We've had our moments. I don't get to Meadow Lane as much now. Mostly the radio or the app.
B: Same. Highlights and the darts, that's me most weekends.
A: Do you play? Darts.
B: Pub league, Thursdays. I'm alright at it. Nothing special.
A: I used to play cricket, village side. Gave up in my forties. Now it's walking, and the allotment.
B: Allotment. What d'you grow?
A: Runner beans did well this year. Potatoes, onions, bit of everything. I keep a planting plan written out.
B: Course you do.
A: Well. It saves guessing.
B: Fair enough. I just keep the back garden tidy. Can't be doing with veg. Holidays, you go away much?
A: Same caravan park near Mablethorpe, every year. Just me and the wife now.
B: Caravan in Norfolk, us. Or Benidorm if Tracey gets her way. I hate airports, mind. All that queuing.
A: We did Majorca once, for our anniversary. It was better than I thought. But Mablethorpe's easier.
B: Yeah. You know where you are with a caravan.
A: You do, yeah. Do you listen to much music on the rounds?
B: Classic rock in the van. Saw Status Quo once, years back.
A: Did you? I've got them on in the car most days.
B: Good band. Bit of Dire Straits an' all.
A: That's me, yeah. Funny, that.
